name: Hangony (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hangony: a blue and green shield with a white church, with a helm, a black eagle crest and red, white, blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed HANGONY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Hangony arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
